text: The Guy Behind the Blooming Sakura
Breeta's ashes are actually dangerous. Virgo has decided to\nmake ashes that are safe to be used for the "Flower Blooming\nChallenge", so let's collect the materials for him!
Breeta who lost the "Flower Blooming Challenge" revealed his\ntrue form! Defeat him and make the Sakura Garden peaceful\nagain!
[[N]]Hand the materials to Pelulu in Day Sakura Garden: Mountains
